fusions.name: Trampling Pass
fusions.desc: Your mount tramples through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Rides the target down under your hooves. It deals 28 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Ridden Steed
fusions.desc: A bonded trail steed walks at your side and fights for you, striking for 5 damage every 1.6 seconds. You can ride it.
